refund.name: Refund Policy
rules: Customers can request a refund within 14 days of delivery.
Damaged or defective products are eligible for a refund within the warranty period.
The product should normally be returned before the refund is completed.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method.
Cancelled orders that were already paid for are eligible for a refund.

replacement.name: Replacement Policy
rules: Defective products may be replaced within the warranty period.
Customers should provide a description of the defect.

delivery.name: Delivery Policy
rules: Standard delivery normally takes 2-5 business days.
Customers can contact support if an order is significantly delayed.
The estimated delivery date is shown in the order record.

warranty.name: Warranty Policy
rules: Warranty duration depends on the product.
Physical damage caused by misuse is not covered.
